entities.name: Maïva Hamadouche
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maïva Hamadouche is a French professional boxer and police officer who held the IBF female super-featherweight title from November 2016 to November 2021. At regional level, she held the French female lightweight title in 2014 and the European female lightweight title in 2015.
